turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Yes! Let me show you one first.
I eat bread. She eats bread.
After "she", the verb "eat" gets -s.
So: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: He sleeps at ten. Wrong: He sleep at ten.

Your turn. Write the verb in the correct form:
My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
